column1: # Game profile of Alien: Isolation (Switch, base game v0 + update v327680). Boots and renders 3D on the Mac and, through Peanuts Native, on an Android handheld
# Feral Interactive's port, SDK 8.2.0, NVN, with Havok and Wwise. Modules main, subsdk0 (the movie module), subsdk1 (GLSLC) and sdk.
# The profile started as the provisional one of scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py; its memory layout held, and mem_used and shader_key_skip were added after the first boots
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − used: a 3328 MB heap region

# the modules are 0x6400000 (100 MB), more than the 64 MB the host reports as used by default: with the default the heap request failed and the game got 0.03 GB. Modules + 4 MiB, as profile_guess.mem_used
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)

# the engine hands some programs the control section of an earlier shader; it differs from the shipped one only in GLSLC's compile information (+0x7d0, 8 bytes: shaders 03749598c3c656f4 and 2b17c56bc893e2b0), so their keys missed the library and all 3D was dropped. The range of Batman: Arkham Knight
